digest.component_or_area: documentation — close workflow, AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED commit; it actually accepts any commit reachable from HEAD, regardless of merge status.
The precheck fires only when the ticket records file_impact and the completion-verification gate is enabled; the docs present it as unconditional.
The docs omit the --ref flag (rebar transition <id> in_progress closed --ref <sha>) which allows closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree.
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism; the docs incorrectly imply the precheck enforces it.
The referencing-commit scan accepts a commit authored for the ticket OR any transitive descendant (via list_descendants); this subtree satisfaction rule is undocumented.
